Transforming Indoor Sports & Entertainment: From Concept to Reality

1. LJ Sports Tech CUSTOMER Case : Live in Thailand

A brand-new digital sports complex project has officially opened in Thailand. Spanning a total area of over 2,500 square meters.

Integrating digital sports, immersive entertainment and lifestyle experiences all under one roof, the venue is fully equipped with premium digital sports devices from LJ Sports Tech. Catering to visitors of all ages, it delivers immersive tech-driven sports fun for teenagers and families alike. Guided by the philosophy of "Share Joy, Discover Wonder", it serves as an all-in-one combining sports, social interaction and leisure.

We recently delivered a state-of-the-art indoor digital sports venue for our client in Thailand. From initial layout planning to final installation and operational guidance, this successful launch showcases our commitment to turning ambitious visions into profitable, high-tech entertainment spaces.

2. Who We Are-LJ Sports Tech

As a pioneer in the digital sports industry, our mission is simple: Make Sports Easier.

We are a direct-source manufacturer (factory-direct) specializing in digital sports simulators. What sets us apart is our end-to-end capability—we independently develop both hardware and software, ensuring seamless integration, superior performance, and continuous technical evolution.

Our premium simulators are trusted by clients worldwide and exported globally.

3.More Than Products: One-Stop Solutions

We don’t just sell equipment; we help you build a complete business. Our full-suite service covers every step of your journey:

  • Site Selection Advice & Spatial Layout

  • Custom Concept Design

  • Hardware & Software Integration

  • Operational Guidance & Support

Whether you are launching a Family Entertainment Center (FEC), a Modern Indoor Sports Park, or adding premium amenities to a Luxury Hotel or High-End Club, we tailor bespoke spaces to fit your business model.
